title: Slow English Podcast #371: 20 Easy Facts About Bulgaria

sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
I am very happy you are here today.
We will learn about a beautiful country in southeastern Europe.
The country is Bulgaria.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Fact one, Bulgaria is in Europe.
Bulgaria is in southeastern Europe.
It is next to Romania, Serbia, North Macedonia, Greece, and Turkey.
The Black Sea is to the east.
Bulgaria has mountains, forests, rivers, beaches, and beautiful villages.
It is a country with many different landscapes.
Fact two, the capital city is Sofia.
Sofia is the capital and largest city of Bulgaria.
It is one of the oldest cities in Europe.
Many people live and work there.
The city has parks, museums, churches, restaurants, and modern buildings.
Sofia is the political and cultural center of the country.
Fact three, Bulgarian is the official language.
People in Bulgaria speak Bulgarian.
Bulgarian uses the Cyrillic alphabet.
The Cyrillic alphabet is also used by many other languages.
Children learn Bulgarian at school.
English is also common, especially among younger people.
Fact four, Bulgaria has a very long history.
People have lived in this region for thousands of years.
The country has Thracian, Roman, Byzantine, and medieval history.
There are many old buildings and archaeological sites.
Visitors can see ancient ruins in different parts of the country.
History is an important part of Bulgarian culture.
Fact five, Bulgaria has beautiful mountains.
The country has several large mountain ranges.
The Rila and Piran Mountains are especially famous.
People enjoy hiking during summer.
In winter, many visitors come for skiing and snowboarding.
The mountain views are beautiful in every season.
Fact six, Bulgaria has a Black Sea coast.
Bulgaria has many beaches along the Black Sea.
The water is warm during summer.
People enjoy swimming, sunbathing, and walking by the sea.
Sunny beach and golden sands are popular tourist areas.
The coast is an important part of Bulgarian tourism.
Fact seven, Bulgaria is famous for roses.
Bulgaria is one of the world's famous rose growing countries.
The Rose Valley is especially well known.
People grow roses and use them to make rose oil.
Rose products are sold around the world.
The rose is an important symbol of Bulgaria.
Fact eight, Bulgarian food is delicious.
Many Bulgarian meals use fresh vegetables, yogurt, cheese, and meat.
Shapska salad is a famous Bulgarian dish.
Bonita is a popular pastry made with thin layers of dough and cheese.
People also enjoy soups and grilled foods.
Food is an important part of family life.
Fact nine, Bulgarian yogurt is famous.
Bulgaria is well known for its traditional yogurt.
The yogurt has a special taste and texture.
People eat it with breakfast, meals, or fruit.
Yogurt is an important part of Bulgarian food culture.
Many people around the world enjoy Bulgarian style yogurt.
Fact 10, family is very important.
Families often spend time together.
People visit their parents and grandparents.
Family meals are special.
Children learn traditions from older family members.
Respect for grandparents is important.
Fact 11, Bulgaria has many beautiful monasteries.
There are many old monasteries across the country.
One of the most famous is Rila Monastery.
It is surrounded by mountains and forests.
The monastery is an important historical and cultural site.
Many visitors come to see its beautiful buildings and paintings.
Fact 12, Bulgaria has interesting traditional music.
Traditional Bulgarian music has a unique sound.
People sing and dance during festivals.
Traditional instruments are used in many performances.
Folk dances are also very popular.
Music helps keep Bulgarian traditions alive.
Fact 13, football is very popular.
Many Bulgarians enjoy football.
Children often play football after school.
People watch matches with family and friends.
Other sports such as volleyball and wrestling are also popular.
Sport is an important part of community life.
Fact 14, Bulgaria has four seasons.
Spring is green and colorful.
Summer is warm and sunny.
Autumn brings beautiful yellow and red leaves.
Winter can be cold and snowy.
Each season offers different activities.
Fact 15, Bulgaria has beautiful forests.
Large areas of Bulgaria are covered with forests.
The forests are home to many animals.
People enjoy hiking and walking in nature.
There are also many national parks and protected areas.
Nature lovers have many places to explore.
Fact 16, Bulgaria has many caves.
There are hundreds of caves across the country.
Some caves have beautiful rock formations.
Visitors can explore certain caves with guides.
Caves are an interesting part of Bulgarian nature.
They are especially popular with adventure lovers.
Fact 17, Bulgaria has many festivals.
People celebrate traditional and national festivals throughout the year.
Music, dancing, food, and colorful costumes are common.
One famous tradition is Baba Marta in March.
People give each other red and white decorations called Martinica.
These traditions are still popular today.
Fact 18, Bulgarians are known for hospitality.
Visitors are often welcomed warmly.
People enjoy sharing food and drinks with guests.
Family and friendship are important.
Many travelers enjoy talking with local people.
Hospitality is an important part of Bulgarian culture.
Fact 19, tourism is important to Bulgaria.
Many visitors come to Bulgaria every year.
They visit Sofia, the Black Sea, the mountains, villages, and historical sites.
Some visitors come for skiing.
Others come for beaches and summer holidays.
Bulgaria offers many different travel experiences.
Fact 20, Bulgaria is a country full of history and beauty.
It has ancient cities, beautiful mountains, sunny beaches, green forests, delicious food, and rich traditions.
Visitors can enjoy history, nature, sports, and local culture.
Bulgaria may be small, but it has many wonderful places to discover.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing, and keep enjoying English.
My name is Emily.
See you in the next episode.
